confirmed_findings.mechanism: Nullable peak_power_w becomes measured-looking 0 kW in the selected-session detail; unlike summary availability guarding.
confirmed_findings.source_repro: Valid typed session with peak_power_w=null: (null ?? 0)/1000 yields 0. Model fallback yields 11 kW (helpers.ts:50), not an observation.
confirmed_findings.recommendation: Represent unavailable observed peak explicitly; keep any model assumption separately identified.

confirmed_findings.mechanism: Empty subgroup mean is zero, so absent AC/DC monthly samples and absent yearly threshold cohorts become plotted/table/export zero readings. Year count includes all dated DC sessions, not qualifying completed threshold counts (72-80).
confirmed_findings.source_repro: DC-only month [120kW] gives AC=[] -> 0kW; year containing one completed DC 50->70 session gives count=1, d10=[], d20=[], both threshold averages=0min.
confirmed_findings.recommendation: Use unavailable subgroup values and qualifying sample denominators; do not silently change accepted arithmetic in this QA item.

confirmed_findings.mechanism: 10->80 and 20->80 labels describe threshold intervals but averages use the complete started_at-to-ended_at session duration for any session spanning those thresholds. No crossing timestamps are used.
confirmed_findings.source_repro: Completed DC 0->100 over 60min satisfies both predicates; both displayed threshold means use full-session 60min. Actual crossing duration is not established by this metadata.
confirmed_findings.recommendation: Explicitly label whole-session durations for threshold-spanning cohorts, or seek an authorized observed crossing-time source; do not invent crossing telemetry.

confirmed_findings.mechanism: Page charts use the header instant range and up to 200 sessions; ML narrator sends only vehicle_id and lookback_days=90; fingerprint narrator sends only vehicle_id. Visible copy does not identify those independent bounds, and fingerprint description asserts the same per-cluster numbers as charts that are actually modeled per-session metadata.
confirmed_findings.source_repro: Changing page range alters start/end query key, but neither AI body includes those range values. Backend response window remains unknown, not inspected.
confirmed_findings.recommendation: Disclose the independent narrator window/provenance and avoid unestablished chart equivalence.

confirmed_findings.mechanism: Home / AC, Supercharger, DC Fast are returned untranslated and appear in Select options, detail values, chart labels, legend names, accessible columns and export categories.
confirmed_findings.source_repro: getChargerLabel outputs English regardless of t/locale; callers directly display its return value.
confirmed_findings.recommendation: Separate stable grouping/color category identity from localized display labels; preserve existing grouping and IDs.

confirmed_findings.mechanism: Seven axis labels use fixed rgba(255,255,255,0.4) rather than theme label tokens. These Recharts label API styles are NOT static-inline-style rule violations, but bypass semantic theme labeling.
confirmed_findings.source_repro: Literal fill is identical in light/dark theme; actual composed contrast is not measured.
confirmed_findings.recommendation: Reuse shared chart label tokens; native/forced-colors contrast remains separate acceptance.

confirmed_findings.mechanism: Three directly re-exported Recharts Bars have neither AREA_DEFAULTS nor chartAnimationProps/isAnimationActive. Shared defaults document vendor requestAnimationFrame animation and its reduced-motion getter requirement.
confirmed_findings.source_repro: Source comparison: corresponding Lines/Area spread AREA_DEFAULTS; these three Bars do not. Runtime animation was not observed.
confirmed_findings.recommendation: Adopt existing motion-aware animation props without changing series, IDs or data.

confirmed_findings.mechanism: SOC range strings use raw numeric interpolation rather than configured locale/decimal precision, while other detail measurements use useNumberFormatting.
confirmed_findings.source_repro: SOC 33.333333 is rendered literally as 33.333333%, independent of a two-decimal/non-English display preference. Missing/nonfinite SOC placeholder is correctly preserved.
confirmed_findings.recommendation: Format finite SOC through the existing number preference formatter while preserving unknown placeholders.

confirmed_findings.mechanism: Missing charger_type and peak_power_w is labeled Home / AC; any nonempty non-home type is treated as DC even without power evidence. No unknown/inferred qualifier reaches labels.
confirmed_findings.source_repro: charger_type=null, peak_power_w=null is valid typed input: isDcSession=false -> Home / AC. This is a rule classification, not an observed AC fact.
confirmed_findings.recommendation: Expose unknown/inferred category provenance without silently rewriting accepted bucketing.

confirmed_findings.recommendation: Use existing chart metadata/description/export context for modeled assumptions and returned-window limits; do not infer backend order.
